JPY.catalyst: The Japanese yen outperforms the G10 complex with a 0.89% daily advance and a 0.64% weekly gain, trading against the dollar below its key 20-day, 50-day, and 200-day moving averages at 158.96, 160.48, and 158.45. Despite a 275-basis-point policy rate differential with the Federal Reserve, mounting speculation of official verbal or physical intervention continues to spur yen repatriation.
